title: Conditional κ = 7.51458925311258·10⁻⁴: addition reordering on #305's weighted gen5b composition (+0.0424% over #305)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.51458925311258·10⁻⁴: addition reordering on #305's weighted gen5b composition (+0.0424% over #305)

One self-contained package, `research/gen5b-weighted-repacked-reorder/` (#305's package with two added transcript stages), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 375729462655629/(5·10¹⁷) = 7.51458925311258·10⁻⁴**, +3.184·10⁻⁷ over #305's 7.51140529238897·10⁻⁴. Bit coarse 7.52024·10⁻⁴, complex coarse 7.54736·10⁻⁴ (#233's word): the bit side binds.

## What it adds

The reorder stage of #299 (where it gave +3.18·10⁻⁷ on the plain gen5b composition), re-screened on #305's final word (after its kernels, second descent, restorations and sinks) and appended after the sinks:

| step | moves | local delta | φ | κ |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| #305 | — | — | — | 7.51140529238897·10⁻⁴ |
| reorder | 237: 212 root deliveries y += h moved past h's sibling deliveries from a rank-21 frame into y's next rank-22 frame; 25 forward gates into an earlier frame of a neighbouring incidence | {2: +237, 3: −217, 4: −25, 5: +5, 6: −20, 8: +20, 21: −212, 22: +212} | −495.07 | 7.51458164306940·10⁻⁴ |
| reorder2 (screen re-run on the reordered word) | 2 forward gates 18 → 16 | {2: +2, 3: −2, 4: −2, 5: +2} | −1.19 | **7.51458925311258·10⁻⁴** |

Each move is a single addition moved, within its incidence window, into the frame of a neighbouring incidence; it is exact over Z because no crossed gate reads the moved addition's destination or writes its source, and rank mass is unchanged (the φ ledger, φ(r) = r·ln(120/r) at fixed deficit, predicted every κ exactly). The lever was found while testing Khattar–Gidney's conditionally clean ancillae (arXiv:2407.17966), whose literal class is empty on these words (every transcript operation is invertible, so no register's content is ever a combination of the others').

**Fixed point.** A re-census of every class on the final word (kernel families, early restorations, sinks, descent, reorder with a widened window) found nothing above 10⁻⁸ (best: 12 descent pair blocks, +2.4·10⁻⁹), so no further stage is added.

## Checks

`reorder_transform.py` (byte-identical to #299's) re-derives every frozen move on the actual word — record content, the anchor frame's exact basis, the crossed-interval rule, disjoint operand sets — and runs the F₂ replay of all 18,944 columns forward and inverse (0 wrong rows), an omission control (999 / 66 wrong rows, rejected), an independent integer replay mod 2⁶¹ − 1 with random dirty inputs (identical on every register), the MOVE rebuild with both reflected ledgers, and #287/#291's exact source-span rule on every gate of its output. Each selection is bound to the hash of the word it was screened on (input `9c8dd18e…` = #305's final word → `96fd1fa3…` → `4b5edb89…`). `verify.py` is #305's with the two stages required (14 stages, 14 omitted-stage controls); everything else of #305's package is unchanged, the new values are pinned in `expected/kernel-pins.json`.

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/gen5b-weighted-repacked-reorder/requirements.txt
    python -B research/gen5b-weighted-repacked-reorder/verify.py --output /tmp/weighted-repacked-reorder   # about 6 minutes

Passes locally (`PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_RESTORE_SINK_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION`, manifest `b3c0a722…`). The workflow (#305's, renamed) runs it and the weighted virtual word regeneration on Ubuntu.

## Scope

Conditional finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses (no Lean certificate for the bit side). #305 and its stack (#275, #300, #296) are open; their word and stages are inherited unchanged. #304's re-annealed complex modules (7635/10⁷) would raise the complex cap further; not needed while the bit side binds.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The base composition is eumemic's (#305; the weighted gen5b matching of #275, rohanarun's restart-packed kernels and second descent of #300); the gen5b word is ours (#296) on DreamingOfClouds' generator (#276/#285); the kernel, restoration and sink mechanisms are Dugongue's (#254/#259/#272/#283) and utcorvusvolat-dotcom's (#280); the descent and target stages are rohanarun's (#287/#291), the target-prefix mechanism eumemic's (#268). This package contributes the reorder stage (first in #299), its re-screen on #305's word and the fixed-point census.
